goal: Allow users and external wallets or indexers to manually protect blocks from pruning via RPC and startup flags
Prevent unloaded wallets and external apps from losing blocks needed for subsequent rescans on pruned nodes
agreement: Substantive support across multiple reviewers with no open objections
Strong support for enabling wallet rescans and external applications on pruned nodes (achow101, stickies-v)
Verified by testing with electrs indexer backed by a pruned signet node (optout21)
Verified by testing prune prevention, startup options, and RPC behavior on a pruned signet node (GEREMIAA)
Minor suggestion open to reject or document ignored height argument during remove (GEREMIAA)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it allows external wallets and indexers like electrs to run reliably on pruned nodes
Avoids full resyncs by ensuring blocks needed for wallet rescans are not pruned while offline
